explanation: erdosproblems.com/888: Cambie and Weisenberg note that the semiprimes show (1+o(1)) (log log n / log n) n ≤ |A| is achievable. The Lean statement gives a function c = o(1) with (1 + c n) · n log log n / log n ≤ max |A| eventually, which is exactly this lower bound for the maximum size. Faithful.
